'''Irex''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he served his [[Sith Master/Legends|master]], [[Darth Skotia]], inside his [[Darth Skotia's bunker|bunker]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when [[Darth Zash|Lord Zash's]] [[Darth Nox|apprentice]] [[Mission to Darth Skotia's bunker|infiltrated]] the base and defeated him. He was armed with two [[Lightsaber/Legends|one-bladed lightsabers]].
